coverage_gaps: Taiwan (JUR-0095): the Sports Lottery Issuance Act covers sports lottery only. General gambling offences (Criminal Code) are not covered by this source and are not listed.
Taiwan (JUR-0095): Article 2 names the Ministry of Education as competent authority while the database category lists the Ministry of Sports; this has not been reconciled.

Hong Kong (JUR-0016): only the Gambling Ordinance (Cap. 148) is listed. The Betting Duty and Hong Kong Jockey Club related legislation and the Home Affairs Bureau / Gambling Commission pages are not covered.
